contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function CellToTrimmedText(ByRef v As Object) As String
            If TypeOf v Is String Then
                Return DirectCast(v, String).Trim()
            End If

            If TypeOf v Is Double OrElse
               TypeOf v Is Single OrElse
               TypeOf v Is Decimal OrElse
               TypeOf v Is Integer OrElse
               TypeOf v Is Long OrElse
               TypeOf v Is Short Then

                Dim d As Double = Convert.ToDouble(v, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                If Double.IsNaN(d) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(d) Then Return ""

                If Math.Abs(d - Math.Round(d)) < 0.000000000001R Then
                    Return CLng(Math.Round(d)).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                End If

                Return d.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
            End If

            Dim s As String = Convert.ToString(v, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
            If s Is Nothing Then Return ""
            Return s.Trim()
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function TryPrepareRows(yCol As Object(,), xRaw As Object(,), zRaw As Object(,), subjectCol As Object(,), visitCol As Object(,), zSupplied As Boolean, visitSupplied As Boolean, n As Integer, pX As Integer, pZ As Integer, readNumber As Func(Of Object, Double?), readText As Func(Of Object, String), ByRef prepared As UdfLmmPreparedRows38, ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean
            prepared = Nothing
            Dim yList As New List(Of Double)()
            Dim xRows As New List(Of Double())()
            Dim zRows As New List(Of Double())()
            Dim subjectList As New List(Of Object)()
            Dim visitList As New List(Of Double)()
            Dim dropped As Integer = 0

            For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                Dim yi As Double? = readNumber(yCol(i, 0))
                Dim subjectText As String = readText(subjectCol(i, 0))
                Dim valid As Boolean = yi.HasValue AndAlso Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(subjectText)

                Dim xRow(pX - 1) As Double
                If valid Then
                    For j As Integer = 0 To pX - 1
                        Dim xij As Double? = readNumber(xRaw(i, j))
                        If Not xij.HasValue Then
                            valid = False
                            Exit For
                        End If
                        xRow(j) = xij.Value
                    Next
                End If

                Dim zRow() As Double = Nothing
                If valid AndAlso zSupplied Then
                    ReDim zRow(pZ - 1)
                    For j As Integer = 0 To pZ - 1
                        Dim zij As Double? = readNumber(zRaw(i, j))
                        If Not zij.HasValue Then
                            valid = False
                            Exit For
                        End If
                        zRow(j) = zij.Value
                    Next
                End If

                Dim vi As Double = Double.NaN
                If valid AndAlso visitSupplied Then
                    Dim parsedVisit As Double? = readNumber(visitCol(i, 0))
                    If Not parsedVisit.HasValue Then
                        valid = False
                    Else
                        vi = parsedVisit.Value
                    End If
                End If

                If valid Then
                    yList.Add(yi.Value)
                    xRows.Add(xRow)
                    If zSupplied Then zRows.Add(zRow)
                    subjectList.Add(subjectText)
                    If visitSupplied Then visitList.Add(vi)
                Else
                    dropped += 1
                End If
            Next

            If yList.Count = 0 Then
                errorMessage = "no valid complete rows remain after removing rows with missing/invalid y, x, z, subject, or visit values."
                Return False
            End If

            Dim xValues(yList.Count - 1, pX - 1) As Double
            For i As Integer = 0 To yList.Count - 1
                For j As Integer = 0 To pX - 1
                    xValues(i, j) = xRows(i)(j)
                Next
            Next

            Dim zValues(,) As Double = Nothing
            If zSupplied Then
                ReDim zValues(yList.Count - 1, pZ - 1)
                For i As Integer = 0 To yList.Count - 1
                    For j As Integer = 0 To pZ - 1
                        zValues(i, j) = zRows(i)(j)
                    Next
                Next
            End If

            Dim finalVisit() As Double = Nothing
            If visitSupplied Then finalVisit = visitList.ToArray()

            prepared = New UdfLmmPreparedRows38 With {
                .Y = yList.ToArray(),
                .X = xValues,
                .Z = zValues,
                .Subject = subjectList.ToArray(),
                .Visit = finalVisit,
                .DroppedRows = dropped
            }
            Return True
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function TryBuildExpandedDesign(raw As Double(,), rawNames As String(), formulaText As String, absoluteColumnLetters As String(), allowRelativeColumnLetters As Boolean, allowAbsoluteColumnLetters As Boolean, allowQuotedVariableNames As Boolean, role As String, fallbackPrefix As String, ByRef design As Double(,), ByRef designNames As String(), ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean
            design = Nothing
            designNames = New String() {}
            errorMessage = Nothing

            If raw Is Nothing OrElse raw.GetLength(0) <= 0 OrElse raw.GetLength(1) <= 0 Then
                errorMessage = role & " requires a non-empty predictor matrix."
                Return False
            End If

            Dim p As Integer = raw.GetLength(1)
            Dim prefix As String = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fallbackPrefix), "X", fallbackPrefix.Trim())
            Dim names() As String = LmmUDFsMetadata38.NormalizeNameList(rawNames, p, prefix)

            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(formulaText) Then
                design = raw
                designNames = names
                Return True
            End If

            Dim designBuild As RegressionFormulaMatrixBuildResult = Nothing
            Dim designErr As String = Nothing

            If Not RegressionFormulaDesignService.TryBuildExpandedPredictorMatrixFromFormula(rawX:=raw,
                                                                                            result:=designBuild,
                                                                                            errorMessage:=designErr,
                                                                                            predictorNames:=names,
                                                                                            formulaText:=formulaText,
                                                                                            absoluteColumnLetters:=absoluteColumnLetters,
                                                                                            allowRelativeColumnLetters:=allowRelativeColumnLetters,
                                                                                            allowAbsoluteColumnLetters:=allowAbsoluteColumnLetters,
                                                                                            allowQuotedVariableNames:=allowQuotedVariableNames,
                                                                                            omitCategoricalReference:=True) Then
                errorMessage = role & " could not be parsed or expanded: " & If(designErr, String.Empty)
                Return False
            End If

            If designBuild Is Nothing OrElse designBuild.ExpandedPredictorMatrix Is Nothing OrElse designBuild.ExpandedPredictorMatrix.GetLength(1) <= 0 Then
                errorMessage = role & " expansion did not produce any design columns."
                Return False
            End If

            design = designBuild.ExpandedPredictorMatrix
            designNames = If(designBuild.ExpandedPredictorNames, New String() {})
            If designNames.Length <> design.GetLength(1) Then designNames = Global.BESHStatNG.ExcelCommon.MixedModelUDFsMetadata38.DefaultNames(design.GetLength(1), prefix)
            Return True
        End Function

            If expectedCount <= 0 Then Return New String() {}

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function BuildValidationFailureMessage(formulaText As String,
                                                       addressingMode As String,
                                                       rawVarNames As String(),
                                                       absoluteColumnLetters As String(),
                                                       parserOrBuilderMessage As String) As String

            Dim sb As New StringBuilder()
            Dim msg As String = If(parserOrBuilderMessage, "Unknown validation error.").Trim()

            sb.Append("Validation failed: ")
            sb.Append(msg)

            Dim fragment As String = Nothing
            Dim fragmentPos As Integer = -1
            If TryLocateOffendingFragment(formulaText, msg, fragment, fragmentPos) Then
                sb.Append(" Offending fragment: ")
                sb.Append(fragment)
                If fragmentPos >= 0 Then
                    sb.Append(" (starting near character ")
                    sb.Append((fragmentPos + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
                    sb.Append(").")
                Else
                    sb.Append(".")
                End If
            End If

            If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(formulaText) Then
                sb.Append(" Formula: ")
                sb.Append(formulaText.Trim())
                sb.Append(".")
            End If

            sb.Append(" Addressing mode: ")
            sb.Append(addressingMode)
            sb.Append(".")

            Dim refs As String = BuildAvailableReferenceSummary(addressingMode, rawVarNames, absoluteColumnLetters)
            If Not LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(refs, String.Empty) Then
                sb.Append(" ")
                sb.Append(refs)
            End If

            Return sb.ToString()
        End Function

Public Shared Function TryLocateOffendingFragment(formulaText As String,
                                                    errorMessage As String,
                                                    ByRef fragment As String,
                                                    ByRef position As Integer) As Boolean

            fragment = Nothing
            position = -1

            Dim formula As String = If(formulaText, String.Empty)
            Dim err As String = If(errorMessage, String.Empty)
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(formula, String.Empty) OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(err, String.Empty) Then Return False

            Dim candidates As New List(Of String)()

            For Each m As Match In Regex.Matches(err, "'((?:[^']|'')*)'")
                If m.Success Then
                    Dim body As String = m.Groups(1).Value
                    If Not LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(body, String.Empty) Then candidates.Add(body)
                End If
            Next

                Dim idx As Integer = formula.IndexOf(exactQuoted, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                If idx >= 0 Then

                    position = idx
                    Return True

                If idx >= 0 Then
                    fragment = candidate
                    position = idx
                    Return True
                End If

                Dim factorFormulaIx As Integer = formula.IndexOf("factor(", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                If factorFormulaIx >= 0 Then

                fragment = formula.Trim()
                position = formula.IndexOf("^"c)
                Return True
            End If

            Return False
        End Function

Public Shared Function ExtractBalancedFunctionCall(text As String, startIndex As Integer) As String
            Dim s As String = If(text, String.Empty)
            If startIndex < 0 OrElse startIndex >= s.Length Then Return String.Empty

            Dim depth As Integer = 0
            Dim inQuotes As Boolean = False
            Dim i As Integer = startIndex

            While i < s.Length
                Dim ch As Char = s(i)

                If ch = "'"c Then
                    If inQuotes Then
                        If i + 1 < s.Length AndAlso s(i + 1) = "'"c Then
                            i += 2
                            Continue While
                        Else
                            inQuotes = False
                        End If
                    Else
                        inQuotes = True
                    End If
                ElseIf Not inQuotes Then
                    If ch = "("c Then
                        depth += 1
                    ElseIf ch = ")"c Then
                        depth -= 1
                        If depth = 0 Then
                            Return s.Substring(startIndex, i - startIndex + 1).Trim()
                        End If
                    End If
                End If

                i += 1
            End While

            Return s.Substring(startIndex).Trim()
        End Function

            Dim vals As List(Of String) = If(items, Array.Empty(Of String)()).Where(Function(x) Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x)).ToList()

            If vals.Count <= maxShown Then

            End If

Public Shared Function BuildParameterNames(varNames() As String, interceptIncluded As Boolean, coefficientCount As Integer) As String()
            Dim out(coefficientCount - 1) As String
            Dim nextIndex As Integer = 0

            If interceptIncluded AndAlso coefficientCount > 0 Then
                out(0) = "Intercept"
                nextIndex = 1
            End If

            Dim predictorNames() As String = If(varNames, New String() {})
            For i As Integer = 0 To predictorNames.Length - 1
                If nextIndex + i <= (out.Length - 1) Then
                    out(nextIndex + i) = predictorNames(i)
                End If
            Next

            For i As Integer = 0 To (out.Length - 1)
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(out(i)) Then
                    out(i) = "Param" & (i + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                End If
            Next

            Return out
        End Function

            Next

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function GetVariableNames(expectedCount As Integer,
                                                isMissing As Func(Of Boolean),
                                                scalarText As Func(Of String),
                                                acquireRange As Func(Of UdfVariableNameRange38)) As String()
            If expectedCount <= 0 Then Return New String() {}

            Dim fallback(expectedCount - 1) As String
            For i As Integer = 0 To expectedCount - 1
                fallback(i) = "X" & (i + 1).ToString()
            Next

            If isMissing() Then Return fallback

            Dim s As String = scalarText()
            If s IsNot Nothing Then
                Dim parts As String() = s.Split({","c}, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
                If parts.Length = expectedCount Then
                    For i As Integer = 0 To expectedCount - 1
                        parts(i) = parts(i).Trim()
                        If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(parts(i)) Then parts(i) = fallback(i)
                    Next
                    Return parts
                End If
            End If

            Dim arr As UdfVariableNameRange38 = acquireRange()
            If arr Is Nothing Then Return fallback

            Dim rows As Integer = arr.RowCount
            Dim cols As Integer = arr.ColumnCount
            Dim list As New List(Of String)()

            If rows = 1 AndAlso cols >= 1 Then
                For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                    list.Add(arr.ReadText(0, j))
                Next
            ElseIf cols = 1 AndAlso rows >= 1 Then
                For i As Integer = 0 To rows - 1
                    list.Add(arr.ReadText(i, 0))
                Next
            End If

            If list.Count = expectedCount Then
                For i As Integer = 0 To expectedCount - 1
                    If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(list(i)) Then list(i) = fallback(i)
                Next
                Return list.ToArray()
            End If

            Return fallback
        End Function

            components As List(Of TComponent), atProfile As TProfile)
            If components Is Nothing OrElse atProfile Is Nothing Then Exit Sub

            For Each component As TComponent In components
                If component Is Nothing Then Continue For

                If Not component.VisitSpecified AndAlso atProfile.VisitSpecified Then
                    component.VisitSpecified = True
                    component.VisitValue = atProfile.VisitValue
                End If

                For Each atValue As TValue In atProfile.ProfileValues
                    If Not MmrmComponentHasProfileColumn(Of TComponent, TValue)(component, atValue.ColumnIndex) Then
                        component.ProfileValues.Add(New TValue With {
                            .Name = atValue.Name,
                            .ColumnIndex = atValue.ColumnIndex,
                            .Value = atValue.Value
                        })
                    End If
                Next
            Next
        End Sub

Public Shared Function FormatMmrmAtProfileDescription(Of TProfile As UdfMmrmAtProfile38(Of TValue), TValue As UdfLsmProfileValue38)(
            atProfile As TProfile) As String
            If atProfile Is Nothing Then Return String.Empty

            Dim parts As New List(Of String)()
            If atProfile.VisitSpecified Then
                parts.Add("visit=" & Global.BESHStatNG.regression.MixedModelPostEstimation.FormatProfileValue(atProfile.VisitValue))
            End If

            For Each profileValue As TValue In atProfile.ProfileValues
                parts.Add(profileValue.Name & "=" & Global.BESHStatNG.regression.MixedModelPostEstimation.FormatProfileValue(profileValue.Value))
            Next

            Return String.Join(", ", parts)
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function TryBuildMmrmAtProfileRowMask(Of TProfile As UdfMmrmAtProfile38(Of TValue), TValue As UdfLsmProfileValue38)(
            modelAvailable As Boolean, design As Func(Of Double(,)), visits As Func(Of Double()), atProfile As TProfile,
            format As Func(Of TProfile, String), ByRef rowMask As Boolean(), ByRef profileDescription As String,
            ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean
            rowMask = Nothing
            profileDescription = Nothing
            errorMessage = Nothing

            If Not modelAvailable OrElse design() Is Nothing OrElse visits() Is Nothing Then
                errorMessage = "the fit does not contain the design rows and visit values required for LS-means profiles."
                Return False
            End If

            If atProfile Is Nothing OrElse (Not atProfile.VisitSpecified AndAlso atProfile.ProfileValues.Count = 0) Then
                errorMessage = "the supplied profile range does not contain any visit or fitted design-column settings."
                Return False
            End If

            Dim n As Integer = design().GetLength(0)
            If visits().Length <> n Then
                errorMessage = "the fit does not contain usable visit values for the saved design rows."
                Return False
            End If

            rowMask = New Boolean(n - 1) {}
            Dim matchedCount As Integer = 0

            Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfProfilePreparation38.FillRowMask(
                design(), visits(), atProfile.VisitSpecified, atProfile.VisitValue,
                atProfile.ProfileValues, Function(profile) profile.ColumnIndex, Function(profile) profile.Value,
                AddressOf Global.BESHStatNG.regression.MixedModelPostEstimation.NearlyEqual, rowMask, matchedCount)

            If matchedCount <= 0 Then
                errorMessage = "no observed design rows matched the supplied LS-means profile."
                Return False
            End If

            profileDescription = format(atProfile)
            Return True
        End Function

Public Shared Function TryGetMmrmAtSpec(Of TProfile As {UdfMmrmAtProfile38(Of TValue), New}, TValue As {UdfLsmProfileValue38, New})(
            arr As Object(,), modelAvailable As Boolean, names As Func(Of String()),
            isBlank As Func(Of Object, Boolean), cellText As Func(Of Object, String), tryFinite As FiniteDoubleReader,
            ByRef atProfile As TProfile, ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean
            Dim rows As Integer = arr.GetLength(0)
            Dim cols As Integer = arr.GetLength(1)
            If rows < 1 OrElse cols < 1 Then
                errorMessage = "at must contain at least one nonblank name/value setting, or be omitted."
                Return False
            End If

            Dim headerlessAt As New TProfile()
            Dim attemptedHeaderlessAt As Boolean = False
            If TryGetMmrmHeaderlessNameValueAtSpec(Of TProfile, TValue)(arr, modelAvailable, names, headerlessAt, isBlank, cellText, tryFinite, errorMessage, attemptedHeaderlessAt) Then
                atProfile = headerlessAt
                Return True
            End If
            If attemptedHeaderlessAt Then Return False

            If rows < 2 Then
                errorMessage = "at must contain a header row and at least one data row, or use two-column headerless name/value form."
                Return False
            End If

            Dim header(cols - 1) As String
            For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                header(c) = cellText(arr(0, c))
            Next

            Dim nameCol As Integer = UdfDataImportMetadata38.MmrmFindHeaderIndex(header, "name", "variable", "effect", "column", "profile", "at")
            Dim valueCol As Integer = UdfDataImportMetadata38.MmrmFindHeaderIndex(header, "value", "val", "setting", "atvalue")

            Dim parsed As New TProfile()

            If nameCol >= 0 AndAlso valueCol >= 0 AndAlso nameCol <> valueCol Then
                For r As Integer = 1 To rows - 1
                    Dim rowHasAny As Boolean = False
                    For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                        If Not isBlank(arr(r, c)) Then
                            rowHasAny = True
                            Exit For
                        End If
                    Next
                    If Not rowHasAny Then Continue For

                    Dim requestedName As String = cellText(arr(r, nameCol))
                    If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requestedName) Then
                        errorMessage = "at row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & " has a missing name/variable value."
                        Return False
                    End If

                    Dim value As Double
                    If Not tryFinite(arr(r, valueCol), value) Then
                        errorMessage = "at row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) &
                                       " has a missing or nonnumeric value for """ & requestedName & """."
                        Return False
                    End If

                    If Not AddMmrmAtValue(Of TProfile, TValue)(parsed, names, requestedName, value,
                                                     "at row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                                                     errorMessage) Then
                        Return False
                    End If
                Next
            Else
                Dim profileColumns As New List(Of KeyValuePair(Of Integer, Integer))()
                Dim visitCol As Integer = UdfDataImportMetadata38.MmrmFindHeaderIndex(header, "visit", "time")

                For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                    If c = visitCol Then Continue For
                    If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(header(c)) Then Continue For

                    Dim idx As Integer = UdfDataImportMetadata38.MmrmFindDesignColumnIndex(names(), header(c))
                    If idx < 0 Then
                        errorMessage = "at column header """ & header(c) & """ was not found among fitted design columns: " &
                                       String.Join(", ", names()) & ". Use header 'visit' for the visit/time column."
                        Return False
                    End If

                    profileColumns.Add(New KeyValuePair(Of Integer, Integer)(c, idx))
                Next

                If visitCol < 0 AndAlso profileColumns.Count = 0 Then
                    errorMessage = "at must contain either name/value headers or at least one visit/design-column header."
                    Return False
                End If

                Dim dataRow As Integer = -1
                For r As Integer = 1 To rows - 1
                    Dim rowHasAny As Boolean = False
                    For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                        If Not isBlank(arr(r, c)) Then
                            rowHasAny = True
                            Exit For
                        End If
                    Next
                    If Not rowHasAny Then Continue For

                    If dataRow >= 0 Then
                        errorMessage = "wide-form at ranges must contain exactly one nonblank data row. Use name/value form for multiple AT settings by row."
                        Return False
                    End If

                    dataRow = r
                Next

                If dataRow < 0 Then
                    errorMessage = "at does not contain any nonblank data row."
                    Return False
                End If

                If visitCol >= 0 AndAlso Not isBlank(arr(dataRow, visitCol)) Then
                    Dim visitValue As Double
                    If Not tryFinite(arr(dataRow, visitCol), visitValue) Then
                        errorMessage = "at visit value must be numeric and finite."
                        Return False
                    End If

                    If Not AddMmrmAtValue(Of TProfile, TValue)(parsed, names, "visit", visitValue, "at visit column", errorMessage) Then
                        Return False
                    End If
                End If

                For Each pair As KeyValuePair(Of Integer, Integer) In profileColumns
                    If isBlank(arr(dataRow, pair.Key)) Then Continue For

                    Dim profileValue As Double
                    If Not tryFinite(arr(dataRow, pair.Key), profileValue) Then
                        errorMessage = "at value for column """ & header(pair.Key) & """ must be numeric and finite."
                        Return False
                    End If

                    If Not AddMmrmAtValue(Of TProfile, TValue)(parsed, names, names()(pair.Value), profileValue,
                                                     "at column """ & header(pair.Key) & """",
                                                     errorMessage) Then
                        Return False
                    End If
                Next
            End If

            If Not parsed.VisitSpecified AndAlso parsed.ProfileValues.Count = 0 Then
                errorMessage = "at does not specify any nonblank visit or fitted design-column values."
                Return False
            End If

            atProfile = parsed
            Return True
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function AddMmrmAtValue(Of TProfile As UdfMmrmAtProfile38(Of TValue), TValue As {UdfLsmProfileValue38, New})(
            atProfile As TProfile, names As Func(Of String()), requestedName As String, value As Double,
            sourceDescription As String, ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean
            If atProfile Is Nothing Then
                errorMessage = "internal error: AT profile was not initialized."
                Return False
            End If

            If String.Equals(UdfDataImportMetadata38.MmrmNormalizeDesignColumnName(requestedName), UdfDataImportMetadata38.MmrmNormalizeDesignColumnName("visit"), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) OrElse
               String.Equals(UdfDataImportMetadata38.MmrmNormalizeDesignColumnName(requestedName), UdfDataImportMetadata38.MmrmNormalizeDesignColumnName("time"), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then

                If atProfile.VisitSpecified Then
                    errorMessage = "at specifies visit/time more than once."
                    Return False
                End If

                atProfile.VisitSpecified = True
                atProfile.VisitValue = value
                Return True
            End If

            Dim idx As Integer = UdfDataImportMetadata38.MmrmFindDesignColumnIndex(names(), requestedName)
            If idx < 0 Then
                errorMessage = sourceDescription & " names """ & requestedName & """, which was not found among fitted design columns: " &
                               String.Join(", ", names()) & "."
                Return False
            End If

            For Each existing As TValue In atProfile.ProfileValues
                If existing.ColumnIndex = idx Then
                    errorMessage = "at specifies design column """ & names()(idx) & """ more than once."
                    Return False
                End If
            Next

            atProfile.ProfileValues.Add(New TValue With {
                .Name = names()(idx),
                .ColumnIndex = idx,
                .Value = value
            })
            Return True
        End Function

Private Shared Function TryGetMmrmHeaderlessNameValueAtSpec(Of TProfile As {UdfMmrmAtProfile38(Of TValue), New}, TValue As {UdfLsmProfileValue38, New})(
            arr As Object(,), modelAvailable As Boolean, names As Func(Of String()), atProfile As TProfile,
            isBlank As Func(Of Object, Boolean), cellText As Func(Of Object, String), tryFinite As FiniteDoubleReader,
            ByRef errorMessage As String, ByRef attempted As Boolean) As Boolean
            attempted = False
            errorMessage = Nothing

            If arr Is Nothing OrElse Not modelAvailable OrElse atProfile Is Nothing Then Return False
            If arr.GetLength(1) <> 2 Then Return False

            Dim rows As Integer = arr.GetLength(0)
            Dim firstNonblankRow As Integer = -1
            For r As Integer = 0 To rows - 1
                If Not isBlank(arr(r, 0)) OrElse
                   Not isBlank(arr(r, 1)) Then
                    firstNonblankRow = r
                    Exit For
                End If
            Next

            If firstNonblankRow < 0 Then Return False

            Dim firstName As String = cellText(arr(firstNonblankRow, 0))
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(firstName) Then Return False

            Dim firstValue As Double
            If Not tryFinite(arr(firstNonblankRow, 1), firstValue) Then
                Return False
            End If

            Dim probe As New TProfile()
            Dim probeError As String = Nothing
            If Not AddMmrmAtValue(Of TProfile, TValue)(probe, names, firstName, firstValue,
                                             "at row " & (firstNonblankRow + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                                             probeError) Then
                Return False
            End If

            attempted = True

            For r As Integer = 0 To rows - 1
                Dim nameBlank As Boolean = isBlank(arr(r, 0))
                Dim valueBlank As Boolean = isBlank(arr(r, 1))
                If nameBlank AndAlso valueBlank Then Continue For

                Dim requestedName As String = cellText(arr(r, 0))
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requestedName) Then
                    errorMessage = "at row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & " has a missing name/variable value."
                    Return False
                End If

                Dim value As Double
                If Not tryFinite(arr(r, 1), value) Then
                    errorMessage = "at row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) &
                                   " has a missing or nonnumeric value for """ & requestedName & """."
                    Return False
                End If

                If Not AddMmrmAtValue(Of TProfile, TValue)(atProfile, names, requestedName, value,
                                                 "at row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                                                 errorMessage) Then
                    Return False
                End If
            Next

            Return atProfile.VisitSpecified OrElse atProfile.ProfileValues.Count > 0
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function TryGetMmrmDesignColumnValues(design As Double(,), names As String(), requestedName As String,
            ByRef resolvedName As String, ByRef values As Double(), ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean
            If names Is Nothing OrElse names.Length <> design.GetLength(1) Then
                errorMessage = "the fit does not contain usable fixed-effect column names."
                Return False
            End If

            Dim idx As Integer = MixedModelUDFsMetadata38.FindDesignColumnIndex(names, requestedName)
            If idx < 0 Then
                errorMessage = "column """ & requestedName & """ was not found among fitted design columns: " &
                               String.Join(", ", names)
                Return False
            End If

            If String.Equals(names(idx), "Intercept", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) OrElse
               String.Equals(names(idx), "(Intercept)", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
                errorMessage = "the intercept column cannot be used as a grouping factor."
                Return False
            End If

            Dim n As Integer = design.GetLength(0)
            ReDim values(n - 1)

            For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                values(i) = design(i, idx)
            Next

            resolvedName = names(idx)
            Return True
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function ParseMultinomialResidualType(v As String) As String
            Dim s As String = v
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s) Then Return "all"

            Select Case LegacyUdfText38.CaseToken(s.Trim().ToLowerInvariant(), New String() {"all", "observed", "fittedmean", "mean", "fittedmeans", "prob", "probability", "probabilities", "fittedprob", "fittedprobability", "response", "raw", "pearson", "stdpearson", "standardizedpearson", "deviance", "dev", "stddeviance", "standardizeddeviance", "leverage", "hat"})
                Case "all"
                    Return "all"
                Case "observed"
                    Return "observed"
                Case "fittedmean", "mean", "fittedmeans"
                    Return "fittedmean"
                Case "prob", "probability", "probabilities", "fittedprob", "fittedprobability"
                    Return "prob"
                Case "response", "raw"
                    Return "response"
                Case "pearson"
                    Return "pearson"
                Case "stdpearson", "standardizedpearson"
                    Return "stdpearson"
                Case "deviance", "dev"
                    Return "deviance"
                Case "stddeviance", "standardizeddeviance"
                    Return "stddeviance"
                Case "leverage", "hat"
                    Return "leverage"
                Case Else
                    Return "all"
            End Select
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function NormalizeMatchToken(value As String, Optional toUpper As Boolean = True, Optional removeUnderscore As Boolean = False) As String
            If value Is Nothing Then Return String.Empty

            Dim normalized As String = value.Trim()
            normalized = If(toUpper, normalized.ToUpperInvariant(), normalized.ToLowerInvariant())
            normalized = normalized.Replace(" ", String.Empty).Replace("-", String.Empty)
            If removeUnderscore Then normalized = normalized.Replace("_", String.Empty)
            Return normalized
        End Function

Public Shared Function ParseMixedModelCovarianceOptimizerModeStrict(arg As String, analysisLabel As String) As Global.BESHStatNG.regression.MixedModelCovarianceOptimizerMode
            Dim token As String = NormalizeMixedModelOptionToken(arg)
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, String.Empty) OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "AI") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "AIREML") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "AVERAGEINFORMATION") OrElse
               LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "AVERAGEINFORMATIONREML") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "FISHER") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "FISHERSCORING") OrElse
               LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "FISHERSCORE") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "SAS") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "PROCMIXED") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "PROCMIXEDSTYLE") OrElse
               LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "AIFISHERSCORINGDEFAULT") Then
                Return Global.BESHStatNG.regression.MixedModelCovarianceOptimizerMode.AverageInformationReml
            End If

            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "BFGS") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "PROJECTEDBFGS") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "PROJECTEDBFGSAUTO") OrElse
               LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "BFGSAUTOGRADIENT") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "PROJECTEDBFGSAUTOGRADIENT") Then
                Return Global.BESHStatNG.regression.MixedModelCovarianceOptimizerMode.ProjectedBfgs
            End If

            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "BFGSANALYTIC") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "PROJECTEDBFGSANALYTIC") OrElse
               LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "PROJECTEDBFGSANALYTICGRADIENT") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "ANALYTICBFGS") Then
                Return Global.BESHStatNG.regression.MixedModelCovarianceOptimizerMode.ProjectedBfgsAnalyticGradient
            End If

            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "BFGSNUMERICAL") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "PROJECTEDBFGSNUMERICAL") OrElse
               LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "BFGSFINITE") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "BFGSFINITEDIFFERENCE") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "NUMERICALBFGS") Then
                Return Global.BESHStatNG.regression.MixedModelCovarianceOptimizerMode.ProjectedBfgs
            End If

            Throw New ArgumentException("Unsupported " & analysisLabel & " covOptimizerMode. Use AI, AverageInformation, FisherScoring, SAS, BFGS, BFGS_ANALYTIC, or BFGS_NUMERICAL.")
        End Function

Public Shared Function ParseMixedModelCovarianceGradientModeStrict(arg As String, analysisLabel As String) As Global.BESHStatNG.regression.MixedModelCovarianceGradientMode
            Dim token As String = NormalizeMixedModelOptionToken(arg)
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, String.Empty) OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "AUTO") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "AUTOMATIC") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "AUTOANALYTICWHEREAVAILABLE") Then
                Return Global.BESHStatNG.regression.MixedModelCovarianceGradientMode.Auto
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "ANALYTIC") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "ANALYTICSCORE") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "SCORE") Then
                Return Global.BESHStatNG.regression.MixedModelCovarianceGradientMode.AnalyticScore
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "ANALYTICVALIDATION") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "ANALYTICSCOREVALIDATION") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "ANALYTICWITHVALIDATION") OrElse
               LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "VALIDATE") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "VALIDATION") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "ANALYTICSCOREFINITEDIFFERENCEVALIDATION") OrElse
               LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "ANALYTICSCOREWITHFINITEDIFFERENCEVALIDATION") Then
                Return Global.BESHStatNG.regression.MixedModelCovarianceGradientMode.AnalyticScoreWithFiniteDifferenceValidation
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "NUMERICAL") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "FINITE") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "FINITEDIFFERENCE") OrElse
               LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "FD") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "NUMERICALFINITEDIFFERENCE") Then
                Return Global.BESHStatNG.regression.MixedModelCovarianceGradientMode.NumericalFiniteDifference
            End If

            Throw New ArgumentException("Unsupported " & analysisLabel & " covGradientMode. Use Auto, Analytic, AnalyticValidation, Validate, Numerical, or FiniteDifference.")
        End Function

Public Shared Function TryClassifyMixedModelResidualCovarianceName(arg As String, defaultValue As String, ByRef canonical As String) As Boolean
            Dim token As String = NormalizeMixedModelOptionToken(arg)
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, String.Empty) Then
                canonical = defaultValue
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "ID") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "IDENTITY") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "INDEPENDENCE") Then
                canonical = "Identity"
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "DIAG") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "DIAGONAL") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "DIAGONALHETEROGENEOUS") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HETEROGENEOUSDIAGONAL") Then
                canonical = "Diagonal"
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "CS") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "COMPOUNDSYMMETRY") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "EXCHANGEABLE") Then
                canonical = "CS"
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HCS") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "CSH") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HETEROGENEOUSCS") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HETEROGENEOUSCOMPOUNDSYMMETRY") Then
                canonical = "Heterogeneous CS"
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "AR1") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "AR") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "AUTOREGRESSIVE") Then
                canonical = "AR(1)"
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HAR1") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HAR") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "ARH1") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "ARH") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HETEROGENEOUSAR1") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HETEROGENEOUSAR") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HETEROGENEOUSAUTOREGRESSIVE") Then
                canonical = "Heterogeneous AR(1)"
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "TOEP") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "TOEPLITZ") Then
                canonical = "Toeplitz (TOEP)"
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "TOEPH") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "TOEPHETEROGENEOUS") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HETEROGENEOUSTOEP") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HETEROGENEOUSTOEPLITZ") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "TOEPLITZHETEROGENEOUS") Then
                canonical = "Heterogeneous Toeplitz (TOEPH)"
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "UN") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "UNSTRUCTURED") Then
                canonical = "UN"
                Return True
            End If

            canonical = Nothing
            Return False
        End Function

source_record.signature: Public Shared Function FindLastNonBlankRow(rows As Integer, columns As Integer, blank As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Boolean)) As Integer

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function FindLastNonBlankRow(rows As Integer, columns As Integer, blank As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Boolean)) As Integer

        For i As Integer = rows - 1 To 0 Step -1
            For j As Integer = 0 To columns - 1
                If Not blank(i, j) Then
                    Return i
                End If
            Next
        Next

        Return -1

source_record.signature: Public Shared Function HasNumericMatrixHeader(lastRow As Integer, columns As Integer, blank As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Boolean), numeric As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Boolean)) As Boolean

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function HasNumericMatrixHeader(lastRow As Integer, columns As Integer, blank As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Boolean), numeric As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Boolean)) As Boolean
        If lastRow < 1 Then Return False

        Dim cols As Integer = columns
        Dim anyNonBlankNonNumericFirstRow As Boolean = False
        Dim anyNumericFirstRow As Boolean = False
        For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
            If blank(0, j) Then Continue For

            If numeric(0, j) Then
                anyNumericFirstRow = True
            Else
                anyNonBlankNonNumericFirstRow = True
            End If
        Next

        ' A real numeric-matrix header should look like labels, not like a data row
        ' with one or more missing numeric values. This prevents explicit data ranges
        ' whose first observation has missing values from being shortened before row-wise
        ' complete-case filtering aligns y, x, subject, and visit.
        If Not anyNonBlankNonNumericFirstRow Then Return False
        If anyNumericFirstRow Then Return False

        For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
            If Not numeric(1, j) Then
                Return False
            End If
        Next

        Return True
        End Function

            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text) Then Return False

            If Double.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, result) Then

            End If

source_record.signature: Public Shared Function ResolveMmrmFormulaColumns(formulaText As String, formulaAddressingMode As String, pAll As Integer, allDisplayNames() As String, allAbsoluteLetters() As String, hasAbsoluteLetters As Boolean, ByRef columnIndices() As Integer, ByRef selectedNames() As String, ByRef selectedAbsoluteLetters() As String, ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function ResolveMmrmFormulaColumns(formulaText As String, formulaAddressingMode As String, pAll As Integer, allDisplayNames() As String, allAbsoluteLetters() As String, hasAbsoluteLetters As Boolean, ByRef columnIndices() As Integer, ByRef selectedNames() As String, ByRef selectedAbsoluteLetters() As String, ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean
        Dim normalizedFormula As String = If(formulaText, String.Empty).Trim()
        If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(normalizedFormula, String.Empty) Then
            ReDim columnIndices(pAll - 1)
            For j As Integer = 0 To pAll - 1
                columnIndices(j) = j
            Next
            selectedNames = CType(allDisplayNames.Clone(), String())
            If hasAbsoluteLetters Then selectedAbsoluteLetters = CType(allAbsoluteLetters.Clone(), String())
            Return True
        End If

        Dim mode As String = If(formulaAddressingMode, String.Empty).Trim().ToLowerInvariant()
        Dim allowAbsolute As Boolean = String.Equals(mode, "absolute", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        Dim allowRelative As Boolean = String.Equals(mode, "relative", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        Dim allowQuoted As Boolean = True

        If allowAbsolute AndAlso Not hasAbsoluteLetters Then
            errorMessage = "formulaAddressing='absolute' requires x to be passed as a direct worksheet range so absolute worksheet column letters can be determined."
            Return False
        End If

        Dim catalog As RegressionVariableCatalog = RegressionVariableCatalog.Build(varNames:=allDisplayNames,
                                                                                   absoluteColumnLetters:=If(allowAbsolute, allAbsoluteLetters, Nothing),
                                                                                   allowRelativeColumnLetters:=allowRelative,
                                                                                   allowAbsoluteColumnLetters:=allowAbsolute,
                                                                                   allowQuotedVariableNames:=allowQuoted)

        Dim spec As RegressionFormulaDesignSpec = Nothing
        Dim parseErr As String = Nothing
        If Not RegressionFormulaParser.TryParseFormulaToDesignSpec(formulaText:=normalizedFormula,
                                                                   variableCatalog:=catalog,
                                                                   designSpec:=spec,
                                                                   errorMessage:=parseErr) Then
            errorMessage = "formula could not be parsed or expanded: " & If(parseErr, String.Empty)
            Return False
        End If

        If spec Is Nothing OrElse spec.RequiredRawVarKeys Is Nothing OrElse spec.RequiredRawVarKeys.Count = 0 Then
            errorMessage = "formula did not reference any predictor columns."
            Return False
        End If

        If allowRelative Then
            ReDim columnIndices(pAll - 1)
            For j As Integer = 0 To pAll - 1
                columnIndices(j) = j
            Next
            selectedNames = CType(allDisplayNames.Clone(), String())
            If hasAbsoluteLetters Then selectedAbsoluteLetters = CType(allAbsoluteLetters.Clone(), String())
            Return True
        End If

        Dim entries As New List(Of RegressionVariableCatalogEntry)()
        For Each requiredKey As String In spec.RequiredRawVarKeys
            Dim entry As RegressionVariableCatalogEntry = catalog.Variables.FirstOrDefault(Function(v) String.Equals(v.BaseKey, requiredKey, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            If entry Is Nothing Then
                errorMessage = "formula referenced an unknown predictor column."
                Return False
            End If
            If Not entries.Any(Function(v) String.Equals(v.BaseKey, entry.BaseKey, StringComparison.Ordinal)) Then
                entries.Add(entry)
            End If
        Next

        entries = entries.OrderBy(Function(v) v.RelativeColumnIndex).ToList()
        ReDim columnIndices(entries.Count - 1)
        ReDim selectedNames(entries.Count - 1)
        If hasAbsoluteLetters Then ReDim selectedAbsoluteLetters(entries.Count - 1)

        For j As Integer = 0 To entries.Count - 1
            Dim originalIndex As Integer = entries(j).RelativeColumnIndex - 1
            If originalIndex < 0 OrElse originalIndex >= pAll Then
                errorMessage = "formula referenced a predictor column outside the supplied x range."
                Return False
            End If
            columnIndices(j) = originalIndex
            selectedNames(j) = entries(j).DisplayName
            If hasAbsoluteLetters Then selectedAbsoluteLetters(j) = entries(j).AbsoluteColumnLetter
        Next

        Return True
        End Function

Public Shared Function AlignMmrmRows(yCol(,) As Object, xRaw(,) As Object, subjectCol(,) As Object, visitCol(,) As Object, xColumnIndices() As Integer, visitSupplied As Boolean, n As Integer, readNumber As Func(Of Object, Double?), readText As Func(Of Object, String), ByRef yValues() As Double, ByRef xValues(,) As Double, ByRef subjectValues() As Object, ByRef visitValues() As Double, ByRef droppedRows As Integer, ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean
        Dim p As Integer = xColumnIndices.Length
        Dim yList As New List(Of Double)()
        Dim xRows As New List(Of Double())()
        Dim subjectList As New List(Of Object)()
        Dim visitList As New List(Of Double)()

        For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
            Dim yi As Double? = readNumber(yCol(i, 0))
            Dim subjectText As String = readText(subjectCol(i, 0))
            Dim valid As Boolean = yi.HasValue AndAlso Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(subjectText)
            Dim row(p - 1) As Double

            If valid Then
                For j As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                    Dim xij As Double? = readNumber(xRaw(i, xColumnIndices(j)))
                    If Not xij.HasValue Then
                        valid = False
                        Exit For
                    End If
                    row(j) = xij.Value
                Next
            End If

            Dim vi As Double = Double.NaN
            If valid AndAlso visitSupplied Then
                Dim parsedVisit As Double? = readNumber(visitCol(i, 0))
                If Not parsedVisit.HasValue Then
                    valid = False
                Else
                    vi = parsedVisit.Value
                End If
            End If

            If valid Then
                yList.Add(yi.Value)
                xRows.Add(row)
                subjectList.Add(subjectText)
                If visitSupplied Then visitList.Add(vi)
            Else
                droppedRows += 1
            End If
        Next

        If yList.Count = 0 Then
            errorMessage = "no valid complete rows remain after removing rows with missing/invalid y, x, subject, or visit values."
            Return False
        End If

        yValues = yList.ToArray()
        subjectValues = subjectList.ToArray()
        ReDim xValues(yList.Count - 1, p - 1)
        For i As Integer = 0 To yList.Count - 1
            For j As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                xValues(i, j) = xRows(i)(j)
            Next
        Next

        If visitSupplied Then visitValues = visitList.ToArray()
        Return True
        End Function

Public Shared Function ResponseColumnsMatchObjects(countData(,) As Object, zeroData(,) As Object, readNumber As Func(Of Object, Double?)) As Boolean
            If countData Is Nothing OrElse zeroData Is Nothing Then Return False
        If countData.GetLength(0) <> zeroData.GetLength(0) Then Return False
            
        For i As Integer = 0 To countData.GetLength(0) - 1
            Dim yc As Double? = readNumber(countData(i, 0))

            If Not yc.HasValue OrElse Not yz.HasValue Then Return False
            If Math.Abs(yc.Value - yz.Value) > 0.0000001R Then Return False
        Next
            
        Return True
        End Function

Public Shared Function TryExtractNonnegativeIntegerResponseObjects(data(,) As Object, ByRef response() As Integer, readNumber As Func(Of Object, Double?)) As Boolean
            response = Nothing
        If data Is Nothing Then Return False
        Dim n As Integer = data.GetLength(0)
        If n < 1 Then Return False
            
        ReDim response(n - 1)
        For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
            Dim yi As Double? = readNumber(data(i, 0))
            If Not yi.HasValue Then Return False
            Dim yr As Double = Math.Round(yi.Value)
            If yi.Value < 0.0R OrElse Math.Abs(yi.Value - yr) > 0.0000001R Then Return False
            response(i) = CInt(yr)
        Next
            
        Return True
        End Function

source_record.signature: Public Shared Function PrepareKaplanMeierRecords(tArr(,) As Object, sArr(,) As Object, gArr(,) As Object, hasGroup As Boolean, ByRef records As List(Of survival.SurvivalRecord), readFinite As UdfReadFiniteDouble38, readStatus As UdfReadStatusInteger38, readText As Func(Of Object, String)) As Boolean

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function PrepareKaplanMeierRecords(tArr(,) As Object, sArr(,) As Object, gArr(,) As Object, hasGroup As Boolean, ByRef records As List(Of survival.SurvivalRecord), readFinite As UdfReadFiniteDouble38, readStatus As UdfReadStatusInteger38, readText As Func(Of Object, String)) As Boolean
        Dim map As New Dictionary(Of String, Integer)(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        Dim nextId As Integer = 0
        Dim out As New List(Of survival.SurvivalRecord)()

        For i As Integer = 0 To tArr.GetLength(0) - 1
            Dim tVal As Double
            Dim sVal As Integer

            If Not readFinite(tArr(i, 0), tVal) Then Continue For
            If tVal < 0.0R Then Continue For
            If Not readStatus(sArr(i, 0), sVal) Then Continue For

            Dim gKey As String = "All"
            If hasGroup Then
                gKey = readText(gArr(i, 0))
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(gKey) Then Continue For
                gKey = gKey.Trim()
            End If

            Dim gid As Integer
            If Not map.TryGetValue(gKey, gid) Then
                gid = nextId
                map(gKey) = gid
                nextId += 1
            End If

            out.Add(New survival.SurvivalRecord With {
                    .Time = tVal,
                    .Censorship = sVal,
                    .Group = gid,
                    .strGroup = gKey,
                    .Stratum = "",
                    .strStratum = ""
                })
        Next

        records = out
        Return records.Count > 0
        End Function

Public Shared Function ComputeSurvivalMedianCi(nRows As Integer, timeArr(,) As Object, statusArr(,) As Object, groupArr(,) As Object, hasGroup As Boolean, alpha As Double, ByRef outTable(,) As Object, unavailable As Object, readFinite As UdfReadFiniteDouble38, readStatus As UdfReadStatusInteger38, readText As Func(Of Object, String)) As Boolean
        Dim tList As New List(Of Double)()
        Dim sList As New List(Of Integer)()
        Dim gList As New List(Of String)()

        For i As Integer = 0 To nRows - 1
            Dim t As Double
            Dim s As Integer

            If Not readFinite(timeArr(i, 0), t) Then Continue For
            If Not readStatus(statusArr(i, 0), s) Then Continue For
            If t < 0.0R Then Return False

            Dim g As String = "ALL"
            If hasGroup Then
                g = readText(groupArr(i, 0))
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(g) Then Continue For
                g = g.Trim()
            End If

            tList.Add(t)
            sList.Add(s)
            gList.Add(g)
        Next

        If tList.Count < 3 Then Return False

        Dim err As String = Nothing
        Dim stratAll() As String = Enumerable.Repeat("ALL", tList.Count).ToArray()
        Dim recs = survival.Survival.CreatSurvivalData(tList.ToArray(), sList.ToArray(), gList.ToArray(), stratAll, err)
        If recs Is Nothing Then Return False

        Dim lr As New survival.Survival_KM_LR(recs)
        Dim mci As Object(,) = lr.BrookmeyerCrowleyMedianSurvivalCI(alpha)
        If mci Is Nothing OrElse mci.GetLength(0) < 1 Then Return False

        Dim groupIds = gList.Distinct().ToList()
        Dim k As Integer = mci.GetLength(0)
        Dim out As Object(,) = New Object(k - 1, 3) {}

        For j As Integer = 0 To k - 1
            Dim med As Double = DirectCast(mci(j, 0), Double)
            Dim ll As Double = DirectCast(mci(j, 1), Double)
            Dim ul As Double = DirectCast(mci(j, 2), Double)

            out(j, 0) = groupIds(j)
            out(j, 1) = If(Double.IsNaN(med) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(med), unavailable, CType(med, Object))
            out(j, 2) = If(Double.IsNaN(ll) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(ll), unavailable, CType(ll, Object))
            out(j, 3) = If(Double.IsNaN(ul) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(ul), unavailable, CType(ul, Object))
        Next

        outTable = out
        Return True
        End Function

Public Shared Function ComputeSurvivalLogRank(nRows As Integer, timeArr(,) As Object, statusArr(,) As Object, groupArr(,) As Object, strataArr(,) As Object, hasStrata As Boolean, weightMethod As String, ByRef result As TestResult, ByRef errText As String, readFinite As UdfReadFiniteDouble38, readStatus As UdfReadStatusInteger38, readText As Func(Of Object, String)) As Boolean
        Dim tList As New List(Of Double)()
        Dim sList As New List(Of Integer)()
        Dim gList As New List(Of String)()
        Dim stratList As New List(Of String)()

        For i As Integer = 0 To nRows - 1
            Dim t As Double
            Dim s As Integer
            Dim st As String = "ALL"

            If Not readFinite(timeArr(i, 0), t) Then Continue For
            If Not readStatus(statusArr(i, 0), s) Then Continue For

            Dim g As String = readText(groupArr(i, 0))
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(g) Then Continue For

            If hasStrata Then
                st = readText(strataArr(i, 0))
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(st) Then st = "ALL"
            End If

            If t < 0.0R Then Return False

            tList.Add(t)
            sList.Add(s)
            gList.Add(g.Trim())
            stratList.Add(st.Trim())
        Next

        If tList.Count < 3 Then Return False
        If gList.Distinct().Count() < 2 Then Return False

        Dim err As String = Nothing
        Dim recs = survival.Survival.CreatSurvivalData(tList.ToArray(), sList.ToArray(), gList.ToArray(), stratList.ToArray(), err)
        If recs Is Nothing Then
            errText = err
            Return False
        End If

        Dim lr As New survival.Survival_KM_LR(recs)
        result = lr.WeightedLogRankTest(weightMethod)
        Return result IsNot Nothing
        End Function

Public Shared Sub ApplyMmrmInference(req As Global.BESHStatNG.regression.MixedModelFitRequest, fixedInference As Global.BESHStatNG.regression.MixedModelFixedInferenceMethod)
                Select Case fixedInference
                    Case Global.BESHStatNG.regression.MixedModelFixedInferenceMethod.KenwardRoger
                        req.EnableFullKenwardRogerForMmrm()
                    Case Global.BESHStatNG.regression.MixedModelFixedInferenceMethod.Satterthwaite
                        req.UseSatterthwaite = True
                        req.UseKenwardRoger = False
                    Case Else
                        req.UseSatterthwaite = False
                        req.UseKenwardRoger = False
                End Select
        End Sub

Public Shared Function MapMmrmNamesByLetter(suppliedNames() As String, suppliedLetters() As String, selectedAbsoluteLetters() As String, inferred() As String, selectedCount As Integer) As String()
                    Dim byLetter As New Dictionary(Of String, String)(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                    For i As Integer = 0 To Math.Min(suppliedNames.Length, suppliedLetters.Length) - 1
                        Dim letter As String = If(suppliedLetters(i), String.Empty).Trim()
                        If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(letter, String.Empty) Then Continue For
                        If Not byLetter.ContainsKey(letter) Then byLetter(letter) = If(suppliedNames(i), String.Empty).Trim()
                    Next

                    Dim mapped(selectedCount - 1) As String
                    Dim anyMapped As Boolean = False
                    For j As Integer = 0 To selectedCount - 1
                        Dim selectedLetter As String = If(selectedAbsoluteLetters(j), String.Empty).Trim()
                        Dim mappedName As String = Nothing
                        If Not LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(selectedLetter, String.Empty) AndAlso byLetter.TryGetValue(selectedLetter, mappedName) Then
                            mapped(j) = mappedName
                            anyMapped = True
                        Else
                            mapped(j) = inferred(j)
                        End If
                    Next

                    If anyMapped Then Return MixedModelUDFsMetadata38.NormalizeMmrmNameList(mapped, selectedCount, "X")
            Return inferred
        End Function

Public Shared Function ReadIntegerOutcomes(data As Global.BESHStatNG.DataObj, values As List(Of Integer), convertDouble As Func(Of Object, Double)) As Boolean
For i As Integer = 0 To data.nRows - 1
            Dim d As Double = convertDouble(data.FinalData(i, 0))
            If Double.IsNaN(d) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(d) Then Return False

            Dim rounded As Double = Math.Round(d)
            If Math.Abs(d - rounded) > 0.0000001R Then Return False

            values.Add(CInt(rounded))
        Next

        Return values.Count > 0
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildFittedTable(fitted As Double(), hdr As Boolean) As Object(,)
            Dim out(fitted.Length - 1 + If(hdr, 1, 0), 1) As Object
            Dim r As Integer = 0

            If hdr Then
                out(0, 0) = "Row"
                out(0, 1) = "Fitted"
                r = 1
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To fitted.Length - 1
                out(r + i, 0) = i + 1
                out(r + i, 1) = fitted(i)
            Next
            Return out
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildResidualTable(fitted As Double(), resid As Double(), n As Integer, hdr As Boolean) As Object(,)
            Dim out(n - 1 + If(hdr, 1, 0), 2) As Object
            Dim r As Integer = 0
            If hdr Then
                out(0, 0) = "Row"
                out(0, 1) = "Fitted"
                out(0, 2) = "Residual"
                r = 1
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                out(r + i, 0) = i + 1
                out(r + i, 1) = If(i < fitted.Length, CType(fitted(i), Object), String.Empty)
                out(r + i, 2) = If(i < resid.Length, CType(resid(i), Object), String.Empty)
            Next
            Return out
        End Function

Private Shared Function CopyArray(values As Array) As Array
            Dim copy As Array = DirectCast(values.Clone(), Array)
            Dim indices(values.Rank - 1) As Integer
            For dimension As Integer = 0 To indices.Length - 1
                indices(dimension) = values.GetLowerBound(dimension)
            Next
            If values.Length = 0 Then Return copy
            Do
                Dim value As Object = values.GetValue(indices)
                If TypeOf value Is Array Then
                    copy.SetValue(CopyArray(DirectCast(value, Array)), indices)
                Else
                    ValidateScalar(value)
                End If
                Dim dimension As Integer = indices.Length - 1
                Do While dimension >= 0
                    indices(dimension) += 1
                    If indices(dimension) <= values.GetUpperBound(dimension) Then Exit Do
                    indices(dimension) = values.GetLowerBound(dimension)
                    dimension -= 1
                Loop
                If dimension < 0 Then Exit Do
            Loop
            Return copy
        End Function

Private Shared Sub ValidateScalar(value As Object)
            If value Is Nothing OrElse TypeOf value Is DBNull OrElse TypeOf value Is UdfSourceCellReference38 Then Return
            If TypeOf value Is OutputCell Then
                Dim kind As OutputCellKind = DirectCast(value, OutputCell).Kind
                If kind = OutputCellKind.Error OrElse kind = OutputCellKind.Number Then Return
                Throw New ArgumentException("Only typed numeric/error intent is used by legacy report projections.")
            End If
            Dim valueType As Type = value.GetType()
            If Not valueType.IsEnum Then
                Select Case Type.GetTypeCode(valueType)
                    Case TypeCode.String, TypeCode.Boolean, TypeCode.Byte, TypeCode.SByte, TypeCode.Int16, TypeCode.UInt16,

Public Shared Function IsPValueLabel(label As String) As Boolean
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(label) Then Return False
            Dim normalized As New System.Text.StringBuilder(label.Length)
            For Each ch As Char In label
                If Char.IsLetterOrDigit(ch) Then normalized.Append(Char.ToLowerInvariant(ch))
            Next
            Return normalized.ToString().Contains("pvalue")
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function NormalizeBlanks(table As Object) As Object(,)    
            Dim arr As Object(,) = TryCast(table, Object(,))
            If arr Is Nothing Then Return Nothing
    
            Dim rows As Integer = arr.GetLength(0)
            Dim cols As Integer = arr.GetLength(1)
            Dim out(rows - 1, cols - 1) As Object
    
            For r As Integer = 0 To rows - 1
                For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                    Dim v As Object = arr(r, c)
    
                    If v Is Nothing Then
                        out(r, c) = String.Empty ' ExcelEmpty.Value
                    ElseIf TypeOf v Is DBNull Then
                        out(r, c) = String.Empty ' ExcelEmpty.Value
                    Else
                        out(r, c) = v
                    End If
                Next
            Next
    
            Return out
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildResidualVectorOutput(vec() As Double, header As String, includeHeader As Boolean) As UdfReportProjection38
            If vec Is Nothing Then Return UdfReportProjection38.FromFault(UdfReportFault38.NotAvailable)

            Dim n As Integer = vec.Length
            Dim outRows As Integer = If(includeHeader, n + 1, n)
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 0) As Object
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0

            If includeHeader Then
                out(0, 0) = header
                r0 = 1
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                out(r0 + i, 0) = vec(i)
            Next

            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildMultinomialResidualOutput(res As Global.BESHStatNG.regression.MultinomialResiduals, categories() As Integer, includeHeader As Boolean, unavailable As Object) As Object
            If res Is Nothing Then Return unavailable
            
            Dim cats() As Integer = categories
            Dim n As Integer = res.FittedMeans.GetLength(0)
            Dim k As Integer = cats.Length
            
            Dim headers As New List(Of String)()
            headers.AddRange(UdfRegressionOutputReports38.CategoryHeaders("Observed", cats))
            headers.AddRange(UdfRegressionOutputReports38.CategoryHeaders("FittedMean", cats))
            headers.AddRange(UdfRegressionOutputReports38.CategoryHeaders("Prob", cats))
            headers.AddRange(UdfRegressionOutputReports38.CategoryHeaders("Response", cats))
            headers.AddRange(UdfRegressionOutputReports38.CategoryHeaders("Pearson", cats))
            headers.AddRange(UdfRegressionOutputReports38.CategoryHeaders("StdPearson", cats))
            headers.Add("DevianceResidual")
            headers.Add("StdDevianceResidual")
            headers.Add("Leverage")
            
            Dim outRows As Integer = If(includeHeader, n + 1, n)
            Dim outCols As Integer = headers.Count
            Dim out(outRows - 1, outCols - 1) As Object
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0
            
            If includeHeader Then
                For j As Integer = 0 To outCols - 1
                    out(0, j) = headers(j)
                Next
                r0 = 1
            End If
            
            For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                Dim c As Integer = 0
            
                For j As Integer = 0 To k - 1
                    out(r0 + i, c) = res.Observed(i, j) : c += 1
                Next
                For j As Integer = 0 To k - 1
                    out(r0 + i, c) = res.FittedMeans(i, j) : c += 1
                Next
                For j As Integer = 0 To k - 1
                    out(r0 + i, c) = res.Probabilities(i, j) : c += 1
                Next
                For j As Integer = 0 To k - 1
                    out(r0 + i, c) = res.ResponseResiduals(i, j) : c += 1
                Next
                For j As Integer = 0 To k - 1
                    out(r0 + i, c) = res.PearsonResiduals(i, j) : c += 1
                Next
                For j As Integer = 0 To k - 1
                    out(r0 + i, c) = res.StdPearsonResiduals(i, j) : c += 1
                Next
            
                out(r0 + i, c) = res.DevianceResiduals(i) : c += 1
                out(r0 + i, c) = res.StdDevianceResiduals(i) : c += 1
                out(r0 + i, c) = res.Leverage(i)
            Next
            
            Return out
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildOrdinalResidualOutput(res As Global.BESHStatNG.regression.MultinomialResiduals, includeHeader As Boolean, unavailable As Object) As Object
            If res Is Nothing Then Return unavailable
            
            Dim cats() As Integer = res.Categories
            Dim n As Integer = res.FittedMeans.GetLength(0)
            Dim k As Integer = cats.Length
            
            Dim headers As New List(Of String)()
            headers.AddRange(UdfRegressionOutputReports38.CategoryHeaders("FittedMean", cats))
            headers.AddRange(UdfRegressionOutputReports38.CategoryHeaders("Prob", cats))
            headers.AddRange(UdfRegressionOutputReports38.CategoryHeaders("Response", cats))
            headers.AddRange(UdfRegressionOutputReports38.CategoryHeaders("Pearson", cats))
            headers.AddRange(UdfRegressionOutputReports38.CategoryHeaders("StdPearson", cats))
            headers.Add("DevianceResidual")
            headers.Add("StdDevianceResidual")
            headers.Add("Leverage")
            
            Dim outRows As Integer = If(includeHeader, n + 1, n)
            Dim outCols As Integer = headers.Count
            Dim out(outRows - 1, outCols - 1) As Object
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0
            
            If includeHeader Then
                For j As Integer = 0 To outCols - 1
                    out(0, j) = headers(j)
                Next
                r0 = 1
            End If
            
            For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                Dim c As Integer = 0
            
                For j As Integer = 0 To k - 1
                    out(r0 + i, c) = res.FittedMeans(i, j) : c += 1
                Next
                For j As Integer = 0 To k - 1
                    out(r0 + i, c) = res.Probabilities(i, j) : c += 1
                Next
                For j As Integer = 0 To k - 1
                    out(r0 + i, c) = res.ResponseResiduals(i, j) : c += 1
                Next
                For j As Integer = 0 To k - 1
                    out(r0 + i, c) = res.PearsonResiduals(i, j) : c += 1
                Next
                For j As Integer = 0 To k - 1
                    out(r0 + i, c) = res.StdPearsonResiduals(i, j) : c += 1
                Next
            
                out(r0 + i, c) = res.DevianceResiduals(i) : c += 1
                out(r0 + i, c) = res.StdDevianceResiduals(i) : c += 1
                out(r0 + i, c) = res.Leverage(i)
            Next
            
            Return out
        End Function

Public Shared Sub AppendZipSummaryRows(rows As List(Of Object()), componentLabel As String, predictorNames() As String, coeffs() As Double, ses() As Double, interceptIncluded As Boolean, ciAlpha As Double)
            If rows Is Nothing OrElse coeffs Is Nothing OrElse ses Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
            If coeffs.Length <> ses.Length Then Exit Sub
            
            Dim zCrit As Double = distributions.ZCritTwoSided(ciAlpha)
            For i As Integer = 0 To coeffs.Length - 1
                Dim z As Double = If(ses(i) > 0.0R, coeffs(i) / ses(i), Double.NaN)
                Dim pv As Double = If(ses(i) > 0.0R, 2.0R * distributions.PNorm(-Math.Abs(z)), Double.NaN)
                rows.Add(New Object() {
                    componentLabel,
                    predictorNames(i),
                    If(interceptIncluded AndAlso i = 0, "Intercept", "Slope"),
                    coeffs(i),
                    ses(i),
                    z,
                    pv,
                    coeffs(i) - zCrit * ses(i),
                    coeffs(i) + zCrit * ses(i)
                })
            Next
        End Sub

Public Shared Function BuildMultinomialSummary(result As LMresult, names() As String, predictorCount As Integer, hdr As Boolean, alphaValue As Double, expForDisplay As Func(Of Double, Object)) As Object(,)
                Dim q As Integer = result.Coeffs_est.Length
                Dim outRows As Integer = If(hdr, q + 1, q)
                Dim out(outRows - 1, 8) As Object

                Dim zCrit As Double = distributions.ZCritTwoSided(alphaValue)
                Dim r0 As Integer = 0

                If hdr Then
                    out(0, 0) = "Parameter"
                    out(0, 1) = "Type"
                    out(0, 2) = "Coef"
                    out(0, 3) = "SE"
                    out(0, 4) = "Z"
                    out(0, 5) = "P-value"
                    out(0, 6) = "OR"
                    out(0, 7) = "OR " & $"{100.0 * (1.0 - alphaValue):0.##}%" & " LCL"
                    out(0, 8) = "OR " & $"{100.0 * (1.0 - alphaValue):0.##}%" & " UCL"
                    r0 = 1
                End If

                For i As Integer = 0 To q - 1
                    Dim beta As Double = result.Coeffs_est(i)
                    Dim se As Double = result.Coeffs_SEs(i)
                    Dim z As Double = If(se > 0.0, beta / se, Double.NaN)
                    Dim pv As Double = If(se > 0.0, 2.0 * distributions.PNorm(-Math.Abs(z)), Double.NaN)
                    Dim pname As String = names(i)
                    Dim isInterceptParam As Boolean = pname IsNot Nothing AndAlso pname.Trim().EndsWith(": Intercept", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)

                    out(r0 + i, 0) = pname
                    out(r0 + i, 1) = If(isInterceptParam, "Intercept", "Slope")
                    out(r0 + i, 2) = beta
                    out(r0 + i, 3) = se
                    out(r0 + i, 4) = z
                    out(r0 + i, 5) = pv

                    If isInterceptParam Then
                        out(r0 + i, 6) = ""
                        out(r0 + i, 7) = ""
                        out(r0 + i, 8) = ""
                    Else
                        out(r0 + i, 6) = expForDisplay(beta)
                        out(r0 + i, 7) = expForDisplay(beta - zCrit * se)
                        out(r0 + i, 8) = expForDisplay(beta + zCrit * se)
                    End If
                Next

                Return out
        End Function
